resources.string: Long-press the profile + button to lend Candy with your own profiles locked.
Enable profiles to use Guest Bubble.
Set up biometrics or a device screen lock to use Guest Bubble.
1. Open the tab overview and long-press the profile + button to start a guest session.
2. Hand over your phone. Your own profiles stay locked; the guest browses in a separate temporary session.
3. End Guest Bubble and confirm with your biometrics or device screen lock. Candy erases the guest browsing session before returning to your profiles.
Guest Bubble protects Candy only. Other apps and your Android device remain accessible. Downloads and exports are unavailable in the guest session.
